name: Katō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Katō city emblem in green: a disc bearing a white stylised bird.
history: Municipal flag of Katō, a city in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 20 March 2006.

features.role: Katō city emblem — a disc bearing a white stylised bird
